title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — October 15, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C4.7)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.4 (Peaked October 15, 2026 at 15:17 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C2.8 (Peaked October 15, 2026 at 02:07 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 475 km/s (Elevated)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.67)

Sunspots look dark because they're cooler than the surrounding surface — but they're still extremely hot. 🌎

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
